label: main title and subtitle area
rationale: This region contains the full presentation title, subtitle, and the lightbulb graphic, which are the most useful standalone visual elements for a training video. It excludes most empty margins and avoids the slide footer area while preserving the key caption bar.

label: full slide
rationale: The slide is a text-only objective slide with no standalone visual region to crop safely. Using the full slide preserves the title and all bullet points, which are the essential content.

label: main table content
rationale: Crops out the slide header whitespace while keeping the full table with all key labels and entries, which is the most useful visual region for training display.

label: main content table and explanatory boxes
rationale: The table and surrounding explanation boxes contain the core comparison and essential labels for the training video, while the slide title/header is less useful. This crop keeps the full structured visual content and avoids unnecessary margins.

label: full slide content
rationale: The slide is a single instructional layout with multiple text blocks and two small visuals; no standalone chart or image dominates enough to crop safely without losing essential context, so using nearly the full slide preserves the title, explanatory text, and the illustrative patent images.

label: Main slide content with examples and labels
rationale: This crop keeps the central educational content: the title area, bullet points, and the four labeled example categories with logos/images. It excludes most of the empty margins while preserving the essential visual material for a training display.

label: comparison grid of products
rationale: This crop captures the main visual content: the four product panels with their images and labels, which are the most useful region for a training video display. It excludes the left-side claim area and minimizes the slide title/header while keeping the essential captions and annotations.

label: main process diagram
rationale: Crops the full central diagram with the INPUT-PROCESS-OUTPUT flow, icons, arrows, and issue labels while minimizing the slide header at the very top.
